shareholder_ratios.Ticker: Notes: P/E, P/B and yields use the current price and latest-FY EPS, DPS and book value (bank book value and EPS as used by Valuation_Engine, which may be interim annualised). ROE 5-year average excludes years beyond Â±100% (negative or near-zero equity, e.g. after the 2022-23 debt exchange). Long-run ROE (5-year basis) = 5-year average ROE, floored at cost of equity and capped at cost of equity + Model_Weights cap; it feeds the engine only when Model_Weights 'Long-run ROE basis' = 5-year average ROE. Total shareholder return uses closing prices from Price_Data and FS dividends per share. Sector medians need at least two companies with positive multiples. New companies: add the row on Valuation_Engine, then copy an existing row here and replace the FS_ sheet name.

valuation_engine.Valuation engine: multi-model valuation: Methods follow standard equity valuation: two- and three-stage DDM (dividend policy tested, irregular payers on 5-year average DPS at reduced weight), DCF (average of FCFE and FCFF at WACC), residual income with persistence, comparables and justified multiples; weighted by sector (Model_Weights). Data from Equity_Model, Peer and FS sheets; assumptions on Inputs section D.

equity_model.Supporting models and inputs: residual i: RI: value = book value per share + PV of (ROE - cost of equity) x opening book value over 5 years + terminal value. DDM: latest DPS grown at ROE x (1 - payout), fading to long-term growth by year 5, plus Gordon terminal value. Both discount at the CAPM cost of equity.

index_setup.Nimed Index: constituents and settings: Market-capitalisation weighted, chain-linked daily (like the GSE-CI). Bank sub-index uses the banks only. Settings come from Inputs (section E).

Method: Index(t) = Index(t-1) x [sum of price(t) x shares] / [sum of price(t-1) x shares], over stocks priced on both days. New listings (FAB Dec 2025, KASA Jun 2026) join the next day without moving the index.
Constituents: Ghana-domiciled GSE equities with statements and share data in this workbook. Excluded: ETI, TLW, AGA, ASG, ALLGH (foreign groups), ALW (suspended), MMH (no share data).
Shares in issue: implied from net income / EPS by financial year (peer sheets); gaps filled from the nearest year; each day uses its calendar year. Price return only, as with the GSE-CI.

bank_data.Ticker: Source: FS_<ticker> sheets in this workbook, compiled from GSE filings and bank annual reports as listed in column R. CAR and NPL as stated by each bank. Interim periods (Q1, H1, 9M) are used when newer than the last annual report; profit lines are annualised and growth is measured against the same period a year earlier. CAR and NPL fall back to the last annual figure when an interim report omits them (see Note). Any other missing figure is left blank and out of the score. Negative impairment = net write-back. ETI (group, US$ reporting) is converted to GHS at the Inputs USD/GHS rate.

NPL basis (column W): banks report NPLs on different bases (BoG prudential gross ratio vs IFRS 9 Stage 3 vs net of provisions). Only ETI's basis is confirmed (Stage 3, FY2025 earnings release); confirm the others against each bank's annual report risk note before comparing NPL ratios across banks. CAR and NPL for ETI are FY2025 (H1-26 report does not state them).
